items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee Happy Caldwell is not present in the transcript; the mention of Clara Smith is made by MR. CLARKE and the INTERVIEWER in a discussion about blues singers.

ctx.x: Yeah, I see. Well, on -- she was hot at this time, was she?

She was tops at that time, because, you know, they had three different Smith, and neither one of the four were ever related, but Mamie, Bessie -- of course, Bessie was the tops. There was Clara Smith. There was Trixie Smith.
